Name: Whale Milk
Author: LotusLemon
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#d4d4d8]Adds whale milk and whale cheese to Stardew Valley. Inspired by the life-long dream of [/color][url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ewen_Montagu]Ewen Montagu[/url][color=#d4d4d8] (WWII officer most well known for his involvement in Operation Mincemeat), who was a cheese connoisseur and desperately wanted to taste the cheese hypothetically made by whale milk (Operation Mincemeat by Ben Macintyre). I'm not sure that whale cheese is actually possible in real life, due to its density, but in Stardew Valley, all things are made possible.[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]Ensure that you have SMAPI, Content Patcher, and Button's Extra Trigger Action Stuff (BETAS) installed to run this mod. Extract this mod into your Mods folder. Run the game using SMAPI.[/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Adds whale milk[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Adds whale cheese[/color][/size][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Adds two letters to the farmer from Ewen Montagu of real life based on the procurement of whale cheese. [/size][/color][/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[size=3]SMAPI, Content Patcher, and Button's Extra Trigger Action Stuff (BETAS) are required for this mod.[/size]

[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Thank you to my friend Emma for translating this mod into Chinese and my friend Grace for translating this mod into Italian. [/color][/size]

[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Thank you to [/color][color=#d4d4d8]my friends who helped me test out this mod. [/color][/size]

Thank you for the people in the Stardew Valley Discord modding channel for your various help and to everyone who helped create modding documentation, which I heavily relied on. [/color][/size]
